answer_1.quote: We adopt the Transformer model and evaluate our approach under one-to-many and many-to-many translation settings... Our baseline multilingual NMT model often translates into the wrong language for zero-shot language pairs, such as copying the source sentence or translating into English rather than German.

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU for translation evaluation with the toolkit SacreBLEU. We employ the langdetect library to detect the language of translations, and measure the translation-language accuracy for zero-shot cases.
